description: The file defines a utility class CatalogContextSeed for seeding initial data into the Catalog database context, including methods to populate catalog brands, types, and items, with retry logic for database availability issues.

classes.name: CatalogContextSeed
classes.description: A static utility class responsible for seeding initial catalog data into the database, with methods for preconfigured catalog brands, types, and items, including retry logic for availability.

methods.name: SeedAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously seeds catalog brands, types, and items into the provided CatalogContext, with retry mechanism for transient failures.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredCatalogBrands
methods.description: Returns an IEnumerable of CatalogBrand objects representing predefined catalog brands.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredCatalogTypes
methods.description: Returns an IEnumerable of CatalogType objects representing predefined catalog types.

methods.name: GetPreconfiguredItems
methods.description: Returns an IEnumerable of CatalogItem objects representing predefined catalog items.
